“Song of the Immortal Drink” by Li Bai
Do you not see, the waters of the Yellow River, descending from the sky,
Rushing to the ocean, never to return?
Do you not see, the bright mirror in the high hall reflecting sorrowful white hair,
Once black as silk in the morning, now turned snowy by evening?
